rules.statement: A new point which was not raised in the issues or in the course of the trial cannot be raised for the 1st time in appeal, unless such point might have been raised at the trial under one of the issues raised, and the Court of Appeal has before it all the requisite material for deciding the point or the question is one of law and nothing more.
rules.supporting_quote: In the case of Setha Vs. Weerakoon 49 NLR 225, it was held, “A new point which was not raised in the issues or in the course of the trial cannot be raised for the 1st time in appeal, unless such point might have been raised at the trial under one of the issues raised, and the Court of Appeal has before it all the requisite material for deciding the point or the question is one of law and nothing more.”
